comment: GN-14m: the consumers that the job consumers of .github/workflows/ci.yml runs before a release of binding, each a GitHub repository at a release tag, and the job of the matrix that runs it. install names, in place of the goal install, the items that install what the consumer's steps need, each one bundle of make arguments of its Makefile (a goal and its variables), when its goal install is missing or does not install all of it; path names the directories of the clone that the consumer's own CI puts on PATH after its install.
